cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded travel card with IndiGo Airlines offering 6E Rewards on flight bookings, dining, and partner spends, tailored for budget-conscious frequent flyers.

benefitRows.name: Dining
benefitRows.offer: Complimentary access to Dineout Passport will allow the cardholders to access 2000+ premium restaurants and bars, including 5-star hotels in India offering a minimum of 25% discount, 1+1 on food, drinks, and buffets.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Pay your bill using HDFC credit card on Dineout Pay.

benefitRows.name: Travel
benefitRows.offer: 1 complimentary flight ticket worth Rs.1500, 1 complimentary 6E Prime Add-On - Priority check-in, choice of seat, a complimentary meal.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Customer needs to make minimum 3 transactions in each of the first 3 months starting from the date of card issued.
